app_fee.value: The College's application fee is $85.00 USD, non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: A non-refundable application fee of $85.00 USD

deadline.value: The College's priority deadline for fall 2027 entry is December 1, 2026; later applications are reviewed on a space-available basis.

gre_general.value: The College says the GRE is not required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty before applying, but admission does not require a supervisor.
supervisor.quote: Potential applicants are strongly encouraged to contact faculty experts in their field of expertise

funding.value: All admitted doctoral students receive financial assistance: a monthly stipend and a full tuition waiver.
funding.quote: all doctoral students receive financial assistance including a monthly stipend and a full tuition waiver

entry_route.value: The Department admits students with BS or MS degrees in Biomedical Engineering or related science and engineering fields.
entry_route.quote: In general, the Department admits students with BS or MS degrees in Biomedical Engineering or related science and engineering fields, or students with MD degrees with undergraduate degrees in sciences or engineering.

notes: College of Engineering PhD rules (one page for all six departments). The college admits PhD students only for fall. The college international page (grad.miami.edu) sets the English test rules, so no English override. Department PhD pages were not fetched separately. The Medical Physics emphasis is listed under the BME PhD; its MS is the main medical physics route.
